steps.name: Library size, PCA, and sample-distance QC (raw counts)
caveats: sample_01's library size is ~4x below the median — do not drop it silently; report its library size and detected-gene count beside the other 11 and give a stated reason for any exclusion recommendation
vst must be run with blind=TRUE (dispersion estimated ignoring the condition design) so the QC view is not shaped by the comparison it is meant to check
This step is descriptive/QC only per the research question — it makes no differential expression claim and should not be extended to one
steps.question: Across the 12 skin samples (6 AD-lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, 12000-gene Salmon counts), what are the library sizes and detected-gene counts per sample, how do the samples separate on a PCA and sample-to-sample distance heatmap of variance-stabilized expression, and does sample_01 (flagged ~4x below median library size) show evidence — outlier position on PCA/distance heatmap, unusually low detected-gene count — that supports excluding it, or does it merely reflect lower depth that the model's size factors would absorb?

grounding.reason: Sample structure QC (R-0033) run blind to condition on raw Salmon gene counts: vst(blind), PCA on top-500-variance genes, Euclidean sample distance heatmap; the flagged low-depth sample sample_01 is kept through QC, inspected, and reported per R-0008, with R-0030 noting that depth alone (absorbed by DESeq2 size factors) is not by itself a removal criterion — the verdict must rest on what the PCA/distance/detected-gene evidence shows.

constraints: Use vst(..., blind = TRUE) from DESeq2, not the rlog or a manual log-CPM, for the PCA/distance input
PCA restricted to the 500 highest-variance genes across samples, per the grounded default
Sample distance heatmap must use all 12 samples and full Euclidean distance on the vst matrix (not a subset)
acceptance_criteria: Reports raw library size (total counts) and number of detected genes (count > 0) per sample, in a table ordered by library size, with sample_01 explicitly annotated against the median and against the other 11 samples
Applies DESeq2 vst(blind=TRUE) to the raw count matrix (12000 x 12) before any PCA or distance computation, per the grounded rule R-0033/R-0008
Produces a PCA plot (PC1 vs PC2, with % variance explained) on the top 500 most-variable genes from the vst matrix, colored by condition (AD-lesional vs control), with sample_01 labeled
Produces a full 12x12 Euclidean sample-to-sample distance heatmap on the vst matrix, hierarchically clustered, with condition annotated
States explicitly whether sample_01 clusters with its assigned condition group or departs from it on both the PCA and the distance heatmap

Gives a stated, evidence-based verdict on sample_01 (keep with the noted caveat vs. exclude with a stated reason) rather than a default action — per rule R-0008/R-0030, depth alone is not sufficient grounds for removal
No differential expression test, gene filtering for modeling, or enrichment step is run — this step is QC-only as the research question requires

plan.title: AD skin bulk RNA-seq: sample structure QC only
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks only for sample-level QC before any differential testing: library sizes, PCA, sample-to-sample distances, and a verdict on the low-depth sample. The data context gives 12 skin samples (6 AD-lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch) as a 12000 x 13 raw Salmon gene-count matrix, with sample_01 flagged at ~4x below median library size. Per the grounded QC procedure (DESeq2 vst-blind, PCA on top-500-variance genes, Euclidean sample-distance heatmap), the single step: (1) computes and reports raw library sizes and detected-gene counts per sample, (2) applies a blind variance-stabilizing transform so the QC is independent of the condition/design, (3) runs PCA colored by condition, (4) computes a full pairwise sample-distance heatmap, and (5) gives a stated verdict on sample_01 following the explicit rule that a low-depth sample is kept, inspected, and reported rather than dropped by default — removal only follows a stated reason from what the PCA/distance/detected-gene evidence actually shows. No DE test, filtering for modeling, or enrichment is run, since none of that was asked for.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap + library size barplot
